control-tower.description: openIndu independent control layer: maintains routing info, Agent principles, agent definitions; directs sub-repo template/script/Agent-prompt updates.

openIndu-website.description: Aggregate dev repo: submodule-aggregates backend + admin + portal; docker-compose local stack; RULE 11 steps 4+5 entry is this repo's own /release command (not the plugin's /build).

production_db.note: RULE 10 production-SQL protection target. Host, port, database and credentials are all injected via vault or env — never committed to this repo.

openIndu-backend.description: FastAPI Web API (8004) + MCP Server (8005); depends on PostgreSQL + Milvus + Aliyun OSS.

openIndu-studio.release_flow: independent library — not in the openIndu-website submodule aggregate; produces no container image and has no manifest in infra-deploy, so delivery ends at its own reviewed repository change
openIndu-studio.description: AI-assisted PLC/HMI program development toolchain: electrical-module survey, circuit design, BOM generation, IO-address planning through PLC/HMI programming; includes RAG knowledge base and MCP tools. Python 99%. GitHub is the authoritative source (confirmed 2026-08-04); Gitee is mirror only — if a local clone points at Gitee, switch origin.

openIndu-platform.release_flow: independent — not in the openIndu-website submodule aggregate; image build and deploy per its own pipeline

pending_rewrite.note: Python→Rust rewrite (Modbus driver / edge alarm / data transform). Rust file count on main is 0; the rust role covers this in-flight work.

openIndu-platform.description: Industrial-internet platform (IIoT base): device access, data pipeline, application runtime (platform layer). Long-term moat. Polyglot monorepo — a single type can't express its stack; dispatch must descend to module granularity.

pending_split.status: open, CI blocked on the SUBMODULE_TOKEN secret
pending_split.note: src/OpenIndu.Station.Vision → openIndu-vision and src/OpenIndu.Station.Scan → openIndu-cim, remounted as submodules at the same paths. The `modules` list above still names all 8 because #173 has not merged and main still holds the sources. Once it merges, drop those two entries here — the GitHub tree API does not traverse submodules, so scripts/detect-modules.mjs will start reporting 6 modules for this repo and --check would otherwise fail.

openindu-station.description: Self-developed station app (described as openindu-motor): 8 .csproj, 180 .cs. Includes motion control, vision, scan, dispensing and laser-cutting apps. The only repo in the org with a standalone test project (Verify).

openIndu-vision.release_flow: source / submodule-only, per openIndu-vision-product/spec/vision-001-form-and-contracts.md. The vision code still lives in-tree at openindu-station/src/OpenIndu.Station.Vision (a directory on openindu-station/main, no .gitmodules yet); openindu-station#173, a stalled all-in-one vision+scan split, is unmerged and superseded for vision by spec/vision-001, which re-extracts vision alone from current openindu-station/main and mounts it back at the same path as a submodule of openindu-station. No mirror, no container image, no infra-deploy manifest — RULE 11 ends at the parent's submodule-pointer PR in openindu-station; changing it is a two-PR flow (this repo, then the pointer bump). Goal per spec/vision-001, not yet true: the kernel builds standalone under `dotnet build` once the Vision.Contracts extraction severs the relative-path dependency on OpenIndu.Station.Core. Standalone CLI / IDE distribution is out of scope for vision-001 — a future spec covers it (see spec/vision-001 §4.7).
openIndu-vision.description: Vision subsystem: camera HAL (Hikvision MVS / Cognex In-Sight / simulator), calibration, and vision tools (BlobLocator / OpenCvSharp4 / MVTec Halcon). net48, x64, WinForms. The three vendor SDKs are conditionally compiled — their commercial DLLs are never redistributed, so a machine without them still builds cleanly. This repo's current content (7491063a) is a stale 2026-08-25 subtree-split snapshot — no consumer, missing openindu-station a1b8d85's CognexCamera fix; spec/vision-001's clean re-extraction resets it.

openIndu-cim.release_flow: submodule — mounted into openindu-station at src/OpenIndu.Station.Scan. No image, no infra-deploy manifest, so RULE 11 ends at the parent's submodule-pointer PR. Does NOT build standalone, same Core relative-path reason as openIndu-vision.
openIndu-cim.description: CIM subsystem (product traceability), split out of openindu-station on 2026-08-25 with its own history preserved (git subtree split, 3 commits). Today it holds one module — the barcode-scanner HAL (Cognex DataMan / simulator). Broader CIM capability (traceability records, MES/ERP interfaces, work-order flow) is intended to land here rather than back in the station repo. net48, x64. The DataMan SDK is conditionally compiled.

openIndu-controller.release_flow: independent — not in the openIndu-website submodule aggregate; edge deploy differs from cluster
openIndu-controller.description: Edge controller, connecting real industrial devices (collect/dispatch); the hands and feet of the industrial loop (edge layer). 3 .csproj, 110 .cs.

divergence.patch_scope: plc4net/ entirely (40 .cs / 6 .csproj / 1 .sln / 1 .props) + 1 .NET CI workflow; Java / Go / Ruby / C untouched.
divergence.patch_nature: net452→net8.0 migration, SPI3 driver runtime implementation, API alignment (Field→Tag), bit codec and ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer fixes, plus 929 lines of new tests.

plc4x.description: Fork of Apache PLC4X (industrial-protocol adapter). The org's largest code body (~197 MB): Java 73% / Go 8% / Ruby 7% / C# 4% / C 3%. Local patches are 100% in plc4net/ (the .NET subproject), owned by the station-control role — upstream Java/Go/Ruby code is never modified and needs no corresponding language role. Behind upstream by 18 commits; periodic rebase required.

openplc-runtime.description: Fork of OpenPLC Runtime v4. Python 37% / C 35% / C++ 25%. Zero local changes — pure mirror, only 41 commits behind upstream. Needs no delivery role; just a sync strategy: periodic fast-forward, or archive once no longer needed.

community.description: Community governance docs. No business code; no agent assigned.

infra-deploy.description: K8s manifest sole home (Deployment/Service/ConfigMap/Secret/Ingress). The openIndu-website/ subdir corresponds to this platform. PR title/body in English (RULE 9).
